info.title: WMS SaaS Core API
info.description:
Domain-agnostic multi-tenant SaaS platform API.
Provides: tenancy, auth, RBAC/ABAC, billing, notifications, webhooks, audit, quota management.

Authentication:
  - **JWT Bearer**: Login via `POST /api/v1/auth/login`
  - **API Key**: Header `Authorization: ApiKey wms_{key}`

Tenant Resolution:
  - Header `X-Tenant-Code: {tenantCode}`
  - OR subdomain: `{tenantCode}.yourdomain.com`

All endpoints (except @Public) require:
  1. Authentication header
  2. X-Tenant-Code header (or subdomain)
